recentItems.description:
Heavy and incessant rains have caused extensive disruption in Bhadradri Kothagudem district, resulting in a breach of the temporary ring bund constructed at the Pedda Vagu project near Gummadavalli in Aswaraopeta mandal. Streams, rivulets, and tanks across the constituency are overflowing dangerously. Roads in almost all villages have been submerged, paralyzing normal life. With floodwaters entering homes, authorities are evacuating people from low-lying areas to safer locations.
